name: Motionflare
summary: Turns a website URL or an idea into on-brand motion-graphics videos or live-action commercials, with music and voiceover, refined by chat.
description: Turns a website URL or an idea into on-brand motion-graphics videos or live-action commercials, with music and voiceover, refined by chat.

pricing.details: Credit pack 14 € for 40 credits, pay as you go, credits never expire. Pro 26 €/month (100 credits/month, 1080p/4K export without watermark, all AI and video models). Max 90 €/month (500 credits/month). Ultra 867 €/month (5,000 credits/month, plus 1-on-1 support). The 0 € plan is 6 one-time preview credits, 1 project, 10s watermarked previews, English voiceover; export needs a credit pack or a paid plan, so this is not a lasting free allowance. Official Black Friday promo, until 1 Dec 2026: 50% off the first month of Pro or Max only (13 € then 26 €/month, or 45 € then 90 €/month) — not the normal list price.
